newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday :

** The Dow Jones industrial average soared to its 32nd record of the year, rising 96.53 points to 6,177.71 as investors bet President Clinton and the Republican-led Congress would keep the economy growing, propelling corporate earnings higher.

** Indonesia's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.41 percent in October following a decline of 0.04 percent in September. Year-on-year inflation was 6.56 percent in October, compared with 6.79 percent the previous month. Indonesia had a trade surplus of $937.89 million in August, compared with $508.5 million in July.

** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.47 points, or 0.59 percent, to close at 587.34 on Wednesday as the latest economic data helped sentiment, which also received a boost from the Bank Negara Indonesia offering.
** On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,332.25/32.75 at 0220 GMT against.
** Indosat on its nine-month net results.
** Astra International on its nine-month results.
** Banking stocks on possible spill-over effects of heavy oversubscription of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) initial public offering.
